description: IGME-CSIC deposits groundwater-availability indicators for 42 monitoring points in Spain's Duero basin. The Zenodo description names annual high-water, low-water and average groundwater levels, annual Groundwater Availability Index values, changes between multi-year GWAI windows, and a quantitative-status diagnostic referenced to 1990 levels. Two public CSV files and two shapefile ZIPs are listed under CC BY 4.0. A groundwater-supply simulation could use the point series to calibrate storage trends or compare mapped stress with modelled drawdown. The index and status classifications are derived analyses, not a full aquifer model. The landing page does not state well coordinates, units, observation gaps or the index formula; those may be in the files. The CSV and shapefile archives were not opened, so point joins and measured-versus-derived fields remain unverified. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Duero monitoring release.
